name: ICD Extraction LLM Benchmark
description: Evaluates large language models' ability to extract International Classification of Diseases (ICD) codes from clinical documentation.
reputation: Niche but important dataset within medical NLP and clinical coding research; moderate adoption in academic studies of automated ICD coding.
notes: High label cardinality and severe class imbalance; potential contamination/privacy issues if models pre-trained on clinical corpora; evaluation can vary by code granularity (ICD-9 vs ICD-10) and dataset (MIMIC vs proprietary).
